rater: author (Nguyen Huu Tien) — bias risk noted
selection_rule: Coherence: same 10 page IDs 1,5,10,15,20,25,28,33,35,39 for A/B/C. Grounding: all 5 test questions. Metadata: 5 test x top-3. Filter: questions with non-null filter.

strategy_A_fixed.note: Fixed 500-char windows often cut mid-sentence on dense instruction pages.

strategy_B_paragraph.note: Paragraph chunks usually keep a whole example or paragraph.

strategy_C_filtered.note: Same chunks as B; filter is query-time only.

metadata_usefulness.usefulness_note: section helps scope voice/gesture/selection queries; limitation: section is page-range heuristic, not publisher TOC labels, so boundary pages may be mislabeled.

grounding_quality.notes: A misses/mislays q19–q20 (biographical/selection prose). B/C retrieve correct page in top-3 but Hit@1 often wrong sibling chunk — partial grounding.
